written: 2026-10-07, before any experimental record was fetched or matched (Addendum B, B2 C0.3)
scope: Li-ion funnel materials (CARD_liion stages S6-S12, plus KNOWN_77) against OBELiX and the Liverpool Li-ion conductivity database

normalisation.formula: pymatgen Composition(formula).reduced_formula after stripping charges, hydrate water only if the database lists it separately, and whitespace; element symbols case-normalised
normalisation.experimental_temperature: room temperature = record temperature in [20, 30] degC; when several RT records exist for one entry, the one closest to 25 degC, ties broken by the higher sigma (stated, not tuned)
normalisation.units: sigma converted to mS/cm; log10 used for every comparison

exact.obelix_with_cif: same reduced formula AND pymatgen StructureMatcher(ltol=0.2, stol=0.3, angle_tol=5, primitive_cell=True, scale=True, attempt_supercell=False).fit(computed, experimental) is True
exact.liverpool_or_no_cif: same reduced formula AND same structure family label (database field, case-normalised); if the database gives no family label for the entry, the pair can be at most family

family.doped: experimental composition differs from the computed parent only by dopant or substituent fractions <= 0.1 per site (computed from the formula normalised to the parent's anion count); doped experimental samples against an ordered computed parent always count as family, never exact
family.same_family_other_stoichiometry: same structure family label with a different stoichiometry

classes.no_match: every unmatched record is kept with its reason: formula_absent, structure_mismatch, family_label_missing, dopant_fraction_gt_0.1, no_rt_value, parse_error

priority: exact beats family; one experimental record may match several funnel materials (polymorphs) only through StructureMatcher, so a polymorph that fails the matcher is not exact
split_inheritance: a matched experimental record inherits the split of its funnel material (I12)
evidence_level: experimental sigma = A (impedance fit). Never a key (I2, I2c)
tests: test_match_exp.py: a known exact pair, a doped family pair, a polymorph that must not match
